policy.no_student_data: A TU result sheet lists other students' names, roll numbers and marks. No PDF bytes and no extracted text are ever committed; PDF evidence is metadata only.
policy.real_bytes_only: Every capture is verbatim bytes from the live site. A hand-written `<rss><channel><item><title>Headline N` fixture proves nothing about the site and is rejected by tests/collection/test_collector_retry.py.
policy.manifest_is_the_index: The manifest, not the directory listing, is the source of truth. An unindexed fixture is one nobody reads and the freshness guard fails it.
